supports: Cross-border B2B digital reporting based on mandatory e-invoicing starts 1 July 2030
Domestic systems remain country-specific during a long phased implementation

title: CATCH compulsory-use FAQ
supports: EU importers must submit catch certificates through CATCH from 10 January 2026
The system was already operational before compulsory use; non-EU exporters and authorities may use it voluntarily

title: Facturation electronique et plateformes agreees
supports: Only an accredited platform may transmit and receive regulated B2B invoices and report transaction or payment data
The registration service monitors platform and user transmission duties and may impose financial sanctions or withdraw repeated offenders' registration

title: Specifications externes et normes pour la facturation electronique
supports: France published version 3.2 external specifications, examples, XSD files, and Swagger definitions on 30 April 2026
AFNOR standards specify invoice and lifecycle-status formats, APIs between enterprise systems and accredited platforms, and B2B use cases

title: Templates to be used in case of unavailability of CATCH
supports: Official fillable templates may be used when CATCH is unavailable
After service recovery the importer must enter the contingency information and attach the marked documents in CATCH

title: EHDS Platform
supports: The HealthData@EU Central Platform is intended to search and filter the EU Dataset Catalogue
The same public platform is intended to submit secondary-use data access applications

title: The state of Right to Repair in 2026
supports: The repair advocacy coalition expected substantial national implementation work to remain unfinished during 2026
The coalition identifies spare-part prices, part pairing, and incomplete product coverage as unresolved barriers

title: Understanding the New Telematics TSI
supports: The new Telematics Applications TSI entered into force on 2 March 2026
ERA's implementation Q&A covers governance, interoperability, APIs, ontology, cybersecurity, and data exchange across passenger and freight actors

title: FERC large-load show-cause orders
supports: FERC identified duplicative or speculative large-load requests as a source of distorted forecasts and unnecessary study work
The orders target those requests with escalating readiness requirements and encourage objective evidence such as physical site control

title: Removing PFAS from community drinking water with granular activated carbon
supports: EPA and a utility used multi-season pilot data covering 16 PFAS species and five commercial carbons to model full-scale GAC performance
The public EPA model evaluated changing concentrations, demand, pretreatment, carbon choice, contactor configuration, and uncertainty

title: Environmental Technologies Design Option Tool (ETDOT)
supports: EPA offers a public software suite for evaluating and designing granular activated carbon and ion-exchange treatment systems, including PFAS applications
The tool is intended to inform utility understanding of adsorption fundamentals, performance, operation, and costs

title: Critical medicines act: Council and Parliament reach provisional deal
supports: The provisional agreement would require contracting authorities to apply resilience-related requirements when procuring critical medicines
Formal endorsement, legal-linguistic revision, and adoption still remained after the political agreement

title: IRIS2 concession awarded to the SpaceRISE consortium
supports: The 12-year public-private concession covers more than 290 satellites and associated ground infrastructure for governmental services by 2030
Three network operators and a named core team of major European primes anchor delivery, while competitive subcontracting is intended to include SMEs

title: EU Space Act factsheet
supports: The proposed common rulebook covers safety, resilience, and sustainability for space activities
Proposed controls include collision-avoidance services, satellite-position sharing, lifecycle risk assessment, cybersecurity, and comparable lifecycle assessments

title: ESA Space Debris User Portal and DRAMA
supports: ESA already provides DRAMA as a comprehensive mission-compliance analysis tool for space-debris mitigation standards
The portal distributes ESA space-debris software, data, patches, licences, and support to eligible professional users

title: AI Factories access modes
publisher: European High Performance Computing Joint Undertaking
supports: EuroHPC AI Factories provide tailored supercomputing access for startups, industry, and scientific users
Eligible AI SMEs and publicly funded research can obtain free access under defined modes, while other industrial use can be pay-per-use

title: MLflow open-source AI engineering platform
supports: The open-source platform already provides experiment tracking, dataset lineage, model and prompt registries, evaluation, and production tracing
Its agent and LLM functions include prompt versioning, observability, evaluations, and OpenTelemetry-compatible traces

title: RO-Crate 1.3 specification
supports: RO-Crate is an open Apache-licensed specification for packaging research objects and structured metadata
Its workflow and provenance profiles provide a public interoperability substrate for research execution records

title: European Commission simplification implementation tracker
supports: Adopted CBAM simplification removes obligations for about 182,000, or 90 percent, of importers
Adopted sustainability-reporting and due-diligence amendments narrow or postpone requirements, demonstrating that compliance surface can contract

title: ESA space-debris mitigation compliance resources
supports: ESA publishes debris-mitigation policy, technical requirements, compliance-verification guidance, matrices, plans, and report templates
Verification spans design, operations, and disposal and points to ESA analysis tools for impact, collision avoidance, and re-entry

title: Data Act explained
supports: The Data Act applies to connected products including industrial machinery and gives users access to readily available raw and pre-processed use data
The access right does not automatically include every inferred or derived dataset, preserving an equipment-specific implementation boundary

title: AWS IoT SiteWise OPC UA data sources
supports: SiteWise Edge directly ingests OPC UA and MQTT industrial streams and maps them to industrial assets
AWS partner integrations advertise connectivity across more than 200 additional industrial protocols

title: US DOT Learning Agenda FY 2024-2026
supports: Approximately two thirds of drivers were reported to have experienced detention in the prior month
DOT cites estimated annual driver earnings losses of 1.1 to 1.3 billion dollars and substantial carrier and safety effects, while noting detention measurement gaps

title: Detention and Demurrage Billing Practices final rule
supports: The final rule specifies who may be billed for ocean detention and demurrage and establishes a dispute process
Common carriers and marine terminal operators generally must issue compliant invoices within 30 calendar days after charges were last incurred

title: DockStamp detention billing
supports: A current entrant already offers GPS-verified arrival, locked timestamps, automatic detention calculation, and export-ready billing packets
The published pilot price begins around 49 dollars per carrier per month, providing product and pricing counterevidence rather than buyer validation for FreightRecover

title: Freight audit and freight payment services
supports: U.S. Bank reports processing more than 46 billion dollars in 2025 freight payments for hundreds of customers and nearly 20,000 carrier payees
The incumbent combines electronic payment, audit, exception handling, data, and working-capital services at substantial network scale

title: Single Market Strategy 2026 annex on late payments
supports: The Commission reports that 73 percent of SMEs suffer from late payments, impairing growth, investment, liquidity, and survival
The same annex says Member States still apply the existing directive incorrectly, so problem prevalence is not proof of reliable enforcement

title: Revision of the late payments directive legislative train
supports: Parliament adopted its first-reading position in April 2024, including payment terms, automatic interest and compensation, and enforcement measures
As of June 2026 the stronger regime remained a legislative proposal rather than an adopted operational enforcement trigger

title: Accounts Receivable Assistant
supports: SAP embeds AI-supported collections prioritisation, customer communications, dispute resolution, account context, and promise-to-pay tracking in its finance suite
The product directly absorbs much of a generic autonomous receivables-agent workflow for existing SAP customers

title: Trusted Agent Protocol specification
supports: Visa specifies cryptographic agent recognition, consumer identity, authorization, and payment-container signatures over existing web, API, MCP, and ACP channels
The protocol addresses trust and payment for agents initially unknown to merchants but does not itself normalize long-tail B2B catalog, quote, contract, or exception semantics

title: About SAP Business Network
supports: SAP Business Network already supports supplier catalogs, discovery, purchase orders, confirmations, shipping notices, invoices, cXML, EDI, email, and online routing
Supplier onboarding and buyer-specific relationships remain part of the control plane, limiting a generic adapter's ability to make any supplier immediately machine-buyable

title: Developer guide to AI agent protocols
supports: Google documents UCP for commerce interactions and AP2 typed mandates for authorization, spending limits, approved merchants, and transaction audit trails
Open protocol work is rapidly standardising agent purchase authorization, reducing the scarcity of a proprietary generic gateway

title: Market Insight: Inland Navigation in Europe, April 2026
publisher: Central Commission for the Navigation of the Rhine
supports: A short April 2025 low-water period had a minor cargo-turnover impact, while a tendency toward low water raised Rhine freight rates in the second quarter
The evidence supports episodic price and capacity stress but not demand for a tradable multi-modal option marketplace

title: Low Water Surcharge Information for Container Transport
supports: Contargo publishes gauge-specific daily surcharge ladders for Rhine container transport and can switch modes when navigation becomes uneconomic
At the lowest water levels capacity acceptance may be constrained and pricing becomes by agreement, showing bilateral carrier control rather than a proven neutral-options market

title: Charter of Access for Industrial Users to Research and Technology Infrastructures
supports: The voluntary July 2026 charter responds to fragmented visibility and access by defining principles for discoverability, transparent access, clear contracts, safe IP handling, tailored support, and cooperation
A public coordination primitive is forming, but the charter does not create automatic booking, scientific qualification, safety approval, or marketplace demand

title: Advanced Photon Source proposal types
supports: APS beam time is allocated through a universal proposal system and requires proposal, experiment-team registration, and safety workflows
Access remains controlled by scientific review, facility policy, safety, and instrument-specific processes rather than a generic capacity marketplace

title: Scientist.com research marketplace
supports: Scientist.com already offers research-provider discovery, proposal collection, approvals, award, contracting, compliance, and spend workflows across thousands of providers and categories
Published marketplace activity is incumbent counterevidence, not independently verified buyer demand for LabGrid

title: Science Exchange R&D procurement platform
supports: Science Exchange offers supplier sourcing, compliance, contracts, payment, performance tracking, and access to precontracted research suppliers
The current commercial platform directly substitutes broad outsourced-research routing and procurement, while its transaction figures remain company claims

title: Allotrope Data Format
supports: ADF is designed to standardize acquisition, exchange, storage, and access for analytical data with contextual metadata, audit trails, electronic signatures, checksums, and platform independence
An open vendor-neutral standard absorbs part of a proprietary lab-software exit model, but documentation alone does not prove complete cross-product restore

title: SiLA laboratory interoperability standards
supports: SiLA publishes an open HTTP/2, Protocol Buffers, and gRPC-based service standard for laboratory-device and software interoperability, including LIMS and ELN integration
Open reference implementations and service discovery reduce the scarcity of a proprietary generic integration layer

title: Share data in Benchling
supports: Benchling documents separate project, notebook, registry, inventory, and audit exports using ZIP, PDF or HTML, CSV, GenBank, and other application-specific formats
Export availability does not establish tenant reconstruction fidelity; format and metadata completeness must be tested object by object

title: eLabFTW experiment export and ELN interchange
supports: eLabFTW exports experiments in an ELN format based on RO-Crate with JSON-LD metadata and supports PDF, archive, ZIP, CSV, and structured API representations
The open interchange format shows that portability can be concrete and testable, but does not prove fidelity between every ELN pair

title: Downloading a Notebook to PDF
supports: LabArchives distinguishes PDF export, whose attachment links still require access, from an offline notebook that includes eligible attachments below a documented size limit
A visible notebook export is not equivalent to a complete portable or restorable system of record

title: Chromatography consumables cross references
supports: Thermo Fisher publishes selectors and cross references for columns, vials, closures, and well plates using method and instrument attributes
The manufacturer explicitly leaves suitability verification with the customer, so lookup is available while neutral substitution liability and method revalidation remain unresolved

title: EU eProcurement vocabularies and ontology
publisher: Publications Office of the European Union
supports: The EU publishes machine-readable eForms schemas, authority tables, controlled vocabularies, and an eProcurement ontology for public-procurement data
These public primitives absorb much of a proprietary tender-normalization and discovery layer

title: Digital procurement tools for public buyers
supports: The Commission provides or coordinates eSubmission, eAccess, eInvoicing, ESPD, eCertis, and once-only procurement services
Official portals and credential controls own core submission and qualification rails, limiting safe autonomous cross-portal submission

title: 3PL invoice audit and recovery
supports: A current buyer-side service already compares 3PL rate cards with invoices, identifies overcharges, supports claims, and offers recovery-oriented auditing
The capability is direct commercial substitution for the broad 3PL Activity-to-Invoice Grid thesis, not proof of market size or customer outcomes

title: 3PL billing and invoicing
supports: CartonCloud converts warehouse and transport activity into charges using configurable rate cards inside its WMS and TMS
System-of-record billing functionality absorbs the supplier-side activity-to-invoice layer and narrows any residual opportunity to independent buyer controls
